steps.title: Stack south
steps.rule: Everyone stacks on C, south of Omega.

steps.title: Main tank pulls Omega
steps.rule: Pull Omega a few metres north-west of the middle; the party stays south.

steps.title: Main tank rejoins the group
steps.rule: Walk around the outside of Omega's hitbox back to the group on C.

steps.title: Column south by number
steps.rule: The two #3s stand just south of the middle (4.5m and 6m out) to take the first tethers. Everyone else lines up behind them, straight south from 12.5m out.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Towers).

steps.title: #4: wait to take the tether
steps.rule: Wait beside the tower closest to your side's tether drop. You take the tether from your side's #3 right after the first Blaster.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

steps.title: Carry the tether to your cardinal
steps.rule: Holding a tether, walk close around the middle to your drop cardinal: the free cardinal (no tower) on your side. The first holders go via south.

steps.title: #1: soak your tower
steps.rule: Walk around the outside to your side's first tower and stand in it on the side away from the nearest tether drop.

steps.title: #2: wait beside your tower
steps.rule: Stand next to your side's tower, a few metres to the side and slightly out, clear of the tower and the tether blasts. You soak the next set.

steps.title: Walk the tether out
steps.rule: Walk straight out to 15m on your cardinal and hold the tether there until Blaster goes off.

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders).

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders has MainTank).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

steps.title: Take the next tether
steps.rule: The next holders (#4 after the first Blaster, then #1, then #2) step to 3m from the middle toward their side's tether holder and take the tether, then carry it out like before.

MainTank.rule: Go to 3m south of the centre.

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Rng).

PhysRangedDps.rule: When FirstTetherHolders leaves out OT, go to 3m south of the centre; when FirstTetherHolders includes OT, go to 3m north of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders).

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 3m west of the centre.

steps.title: Next soaker: take your tower
steps.rule: If you soak this set (#2 after the first Blaster, then #3, then #4), walk around the outside into your side's new tower, on the side away from the tether drop.

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders has RegenHealer).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders has RegenHealer).

CasterDps.rule: When FirstTetherHolders leaves out R1, stand on waymark 3; when FirstTetherHolders includes R1, stand on waymark B.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Stand near waymark 3, 13m south-west of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Towers).

steps.title: Just soaked: get ready to take a tether
steps.rule: After soaking, wait beside the tower closest to your side's tether drop: you take the tether after the next Blaster. After the last set, just stand beside your tower.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders).

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Towers).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

steps.title: Tether passed: step beside a tower
steps.rule: Once your tether is taken, walk to the side of the nearest tower of the new set, out of its circle and away from the new tether drops.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat.

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: FirstTetherHolders has MainTank).

steps.title: Step out of a misplaced blast
